features: Processor and Memory: MediaTek Dimensity 6400 processor with LPDDR4X 8GB RAM and UFS 2.2 128GB storage helps support everyday 5G use, app switching and expandable storage up to 1TB via microSD card
Display Technology: 6.67-inch HD+ LCD display with 120Hz refresh rate, 264ppi, 120Hz touch sampling, up to 1050 nits HBM brightness, Display Colour Boost and Corning Gorilla Glass 7i protection
Camera System: 50MP rear camera with f/1.8 aperture and PDAF supports 2K video recording, while the 8MP front camera supports selfies, video calls and 2K front video recording
Battery and Charging: 7000mAh battery with 30W TurboPower charging and 6W reverse wired charging supports daily use
Durability and Features: IP64 dust and splash resistance, MIL-STD-810H certification, side fingerprint sensor, Android 16, Dolby Atmos stereo speakers, USB Type-C and 3.5mm headset jack
MASSIVE 7000mAh BATTERY: Equipped with a segment-leading 7000mAh battery and 30W fast charging, the Moto g37 Power keeps you going all day without interruption.
BLAZING FAST 5G PERFORMANCE: Powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 6400 processor, this smartphone delivers swift, reliable 5G connectivity for seamless browsing, streaming, and multitasking.
STUNNING DISPLAY: Features a large 6.67-inch HD+ display with a smooth 120Hz refresh rate, offering vibrant visuals and fluid scrolling for an immersive viewing experience.
50MP CAMERA SYSTEM: Capture sharp, detailed photos and videos with the 50MP primary camera, complemented by a versatile triple rear camera setup for every shooting scenario.
DURABLE BUILD: Protected by Corning Gorilla Glass 7i and MIL-STD 810H military-grade certification, this phone is built to withstand everyday drops, dust, and tough conditions.
description: Introducing the Motorola Moto G37 Power 5G, a smartphone engineered to keep up with your demanding lifestyle. Boasting a massive 7000mAh battery — the best in its segment — this device ensures you stay connected all day long without constantly reaching for a charger. When you do need to top up, the 30W fast charging gets you back in action quickly. Powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 6400 processor, it delivers blazing-fast 5G connectivity and smooth everyday performance. The expansive 6.67-inch HD+ display with a fluid 120Hz refresh rate makes scrolling, gaming, and streaming a truly immersive experience. Capture life's moments in stunning detail with the 50MP primary camera, complemented by a versatile multi-lens setup on the rear. Built to last, the Moto G37 Power features Corning Gorilla Glass 7i protection and meets MIL-STD 810H military-grade durability standards, making it resistant to the rigours of daily use. With 4GB RAM and 64GB storage, it handles multitasking and app storage with ease. Available in the stylish Pantone Nautical Blue colour, this phone is as good-looking as it is capable.
